description: This file is a PHP class implementing a migration script for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.7.0. It handles database schema changes, localization string management, permission setup, and cleanup tasks associated with the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class performs the database migration tasks for version 5.7.0 of OrangeHRM, including schema updates, localization string management, and permission setup.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps such as deleting old language strings, creating new data groups, updating language string versions, inserting error records, and setting up tables and foreign keys.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the migration, which is '5.7.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for localization string management.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version number of language strings in the database.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translations for a specific language string identified by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: dropOldTables
methods.description: Drops obsolete tables from the database schema.

methods.name: insertI18NError
methods.description: Inserts a new internationalization error record into the error table.

methods.name: deleteUnusedLangStrings
methods.description: Removes language strings that are no longer used, across various categories such as general, admin, pim, etc.
